hints.title: Boustrophedon Coordinate Mapping
hints.text: Map 1D square labels 1 to n^2 to 2D row and column indices reflecting the alternating left-right winding board layout.

hints.title: Unweighted Shortest Path Moves
hints.text: Each roll advances 1 to 6 steps, modeling an unweighted directed graph where transitions represent dice outcomes.

hints.title: Single Hop Ladder/Snake Transfer
hints.text: If a destination cell contains a ladder or snake, move directly to that destination without chained hops, recording visitations on the initial landing index.

complexity.notes: Breadth-first exploration across N^2 board squares.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unpruned DFS explores infinite loops created by cyclical snake and ladder patterns.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance array/map requires O(N^2) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use clean Boustrophedon index translation and standard BFS queue.
